title: Recorded compile results: lesson compile harness
description:
Acceptance:
- npm run lesson -- compile <id> writes lessons/<id>/compiled/*.json with the /explain response and a hash of source, flags and toolchain version
- lesson check fails on a stale hash
- the player shows the recorded answer at once and the live answer when ready
- browser caches /explain answers by source hash
right_now_summary: The lesson compile harness is being built to record answers, detect stale results, and speed playback.
